title: BBS Player Plugin
description: BlockBuster Studio Player Plugin, BBS Player Plugin or BBSPP is a is a plugin that allows you to send and play BBS Mod films on a "vanilla" server
body:
# BBS Player Plugin
**BlockBuster Studio Player Plugin, BBSPlayer Plugin or BBSPP (i think the last one is funnier) is a plugin that allows you to send and play BBS Mod films.**

This plugin is designed to work with [BBS Player Mod](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bbs-player) on the clients (The plugin is also compatible with all BBS Mod forks

### How to use?
- Store your films data into your server config/bbs/data/films folder (automatically created on the first start)
- THIS PLUGIN DOESNT STORE/SEND BBS ASSETS TO THE CLIENTS! Make sure your client has the assets the film uses
- Run the command `/film` or `/bbsfilm`  <play|stop|list> <target> <film> [Camera]

The plugin also recreates the morph system but is totally untested and probably not working correctly.

### Disclaimer!
In order for the clients to see your BBS Films they must have installed any BBS mod edition compatible with the film created (i think any fork of the mod should be compatible with the plugin since almost all of the forks available use the same system)

- Tested version: 1.21.1
- Tested server software: Paper
- Tested forks: BBS-CML-EDITION (Not totally tested) and BBS-PLAYER (Mine ofc)
